lines.zh: {biome}的波涛之下掩埋着比陆地更古老的秘密。水越深，沉睡之物的梦境便越沉重。
lines.en: Beneath the waves of {biome} lie secrets older than dry land. The deeper the water, the heavier the dreams of what sleeps below.

lines.zh: 你面对着一望无际的{biome}。在这片吞噬了地平线的深蓝之中，凡人何其渺小。
lines.en: You face the boundless expanse of {biome}. Before this deep blue that swallows the horizon, how small a mortal stands.

lines.zh: Ph'nglui mglw'nafh... {biome}的深处或许正矗立着一座非欧几里得几何构筑的巨石神庙。
lines.en: Ph'nglui mglw'nafh... In the depths of {biome} may stand a cyclopean temple wrought in non-Euclidean stone.

lines.zh: {biome}的树冠遮蔽了天日，在枝叶交错的阴影里，仿佛有无数眼睛正在暗中窥视。
lines.en: The canopy of {biome} shuts out the sky; within the tangled shade of boughs, countless eyes seem to watch unseen.

lines.zh: 林木在风中发出吱嘎的声响，像是无数枯骨在{biome}的深处低声交谈。
lines.en: Timber creaks in the wind, as though dry bones were conversing in whispers deep within {biome}.

lines.zh: 凡人总以为{biome}充满生机，却不知茂密的腐殖土下究竟掩埋着多少异教徒的骸骨。
lines.en: Mortals think {biome} teems with life, blind to how many pagan bones lie rotting beneath its rich loam.

lines.zh: {biome}的黄沙掩埋了多少失落的古国与无名神庙？风沙之下，或许正压着一扇通往彼岸的石门。
lines.en: How many lost kingdoms and nameless temples lie buried beneath the sands of {biome}? Beneath the dunes may rest a stone gate to the beyond.

lines.zh: 炽热的烈日炙烤着{biome}，却晒不干某些古老祭坛上早已干涸的血迹。
lines.en: A pitiless sun scorches {biome}, yet cannot bleach the ancient bloodstains from forgotten altars.

lines.zh: {biome}荒凉而枯寂，正如被外神掠夺了一切生机后的死星表面。
lines.en: {biome} lies barren and lifeless, like the surface of a dead star stripped bare by the Outer Gods.

lines.zh: {biome}的绝壁直插云霄，仿佛大地正试图用脊梁去触碰那不可触及的星海。
lines.en: The sheer crags of {biome} pierce the clouds, as though the earth sought to touch the untouchable sea of stars.

lines.zh: 站在{biome}的高峰之上，凡俗的喧嚣渐行渐远，唯有冰冷的虚空离你更近了一步。
lines.en: Upon the heights of {biome}, mortal clamor fades below, and the cold Void draws one step nearer.

lines.zh: {biome}的狂风在岩缝间呼啸，那声音宛如来自极北荒原的古老颂歌。
lines.en: Gales shriek through the clefts of {biome}, sounding like ancient chants carried down from frozen northern wastes.

lines.zh: {biome}的泥沼散发着腐殖与死亡的气息，这片污浊之地与珊瑚荒原倒有几分神似。
lines.en: The mire of {biome} exhales rot and death; this fouled fen bears a striking kinship to the Coralium wastes.

lines.zh: 浑浊的死水与低垂的藤蔓交织在{biome}之中，仿佛每一步都会踩进未知的坟墓。
lines.en: Stagnant water and hanging vines entwine throughout {biome}, as though every step might sink into an unmarked grave.

lines.zh: 在{biome}的迷雾里，鬼火与畸变的生物随时可能从腐烂的树根后悄然现身。
lines.en: Through the mists of {biome}, pale lights and warped things may slip out from behind rotting roots at any moment.

lines.zh: {biome}的硫磺与烈焰翻腾不息，然则比起黑暗国度的冰冷绝望，这片炼狱倒显得过于喧嚣了。
lines.en: Sulfur and flame churn endlessly in {biome}; yet beside the cold despair of the Dark Realm, this furnace seems almost noisy.

lines.zh: 炽热的岩浆河在{biome}中流淌，映照出无数扭曲哀嚎的亡魂倒影。
lines.en: Rivers of molten rock wind through {biome}, mirroring the contorted silhouettes of wailing shades.

lines.zh: 你在{biome}的焦土上行走，脚下是地狱岩永恒的灼痛与永无止境的堕落。
lines.en: You tread the scorched crust of {biome}, over Netherrack steeped in perpetual torment and ruin.

lines.zh: {biome}的刺骨严寒冻结了血流，却冻不住潜藏在宇宙暗面里的恶意。
lines.en: The biting frost of {biome} slows the blood, yet cannot freeze the malice lurking on the dark side of the cosmos.

lines.zh: 冰雪覆盖着{biome}，将生机封死在苍白的坟墓之下，正如黑暗国度那永恒的死寂。
lines.en: Ice and snow shroud {biome}, sealing life beneath a pale tomb much like the eternal hush of the Dark Realm.

lines.zh: 在这冰冷的{biome}之中，连呼吸都会凝成白霜。凡人的体温在浩瀚虚空面前显得何其微弱。
lines.en: In frigid {biome}, even breath freezes to white rime. How feeble mortal warmth is against the vastness of the Void.

lines.zh: {biome}的藤蔓疯狂纠缠、彼此绞杀，宛如一团失去理智的血肉在盲目生长。
lines.en: The vines of {biome} tangle and strangle one another in frenzy, like a mass of mindless flesh growing blind.

lines.zh: 湿热的瘴气笼罩着{biome}，令人想起那些隐藏在失落丛林深处的古老食人祭坛。
lines.en: Steaming miasma blankets {biome}, recalling ancient blood-altars buried deep within lost jungles.

lines.zh: 在{biome}的密林深处，每一次叶片的颤动都可能预示着潜伏者的扑击。
lines.en: Deep within the thickets of {biome}, every tremor of a leaf may herald a lurking predator's strike.

lines.zh: {biome}的赤红岩层如同剥去皮肉后暴露在烈日下的骨骼，记录着大地古老的创伤。
lines.en: The crimson strata of {biome} rise like flayed bone bared to the sun, recording ancient wounds of the earth.

lines.zh: 风化千年的恶地石柱矗立在{biome}之中，恰似无数沉默的巨型墓碑。
lines.en: Weathered pillars of badlands stone stand across {biome} like countless silent monoliths over a forgotten grave.

lines.zh: 在{biome}干裂的土地上，黄金的诱惑曾引来无数贪婪的凡人，最终只留下累累白骨。
lines.en: Upon the parched earth of {biome}, the lure of gold once drew greedy mortals, leaving only bleached bones behind.

lines.zh: {biome}一望无际，平坦得令人心生寒意——在这片毫无遮蔽的荒野上，你无处可藏。
lines.en: {biome} stretches flat and boundless—upon this unsheltered expanse, there is nowhere to hide.

lines.zh: 风吹过{biome}的草梢，掀起一阵阵灰绿色的波浪，宛如大地在不安地战栗。
lines.en: Wind sweeps the grass of {biome} in dull green waves, as though the earth itself were shivering.

lines.zh: 在{biome}的开阔视野中，白昼看似平和，一旦夜幕降临，四面八方皆是潜行的阴影。
lines.en: Across the open flats of {biome}, day seems tranquil; yet once night falls, stalking shadows close in from every side.

lines.zh: {biome}的水流昼夜不息，将山峦的碎屑带向大海，一如时间将所有凡人的功业冲刷殆尽。
lines.en: The current of {biome} flows without ceasing, bearing mountain grit to the sea as time washes away all mortal works.

lines.zh: 这条{biome}在荒野间蜿蜒前行，宛如大地皮肤上一道正在缓慢流血的裂痕。
lines.en: This {biome} winds through the wilds like a slow-bleeding cleft across the skin of the earth.

lines.zh: 站在{biome}岸边俯视浑浊的水面，你看到的究竟是自己的倒影，还是扎哈尔的轮廓？
lines.en: Gazing down into the murky current of {biome}, do you see your own reflection—or the silhouette of J'zahar?

lines.zh: {biome}是陆地与深海交界的脆弱边缘，恰如理智与疯狂之间那道随时会被浪涛吞没的堤岸。
lines.en: {biome} is the frail border where land meets deep water, like the dike between sanity and madness ever poised to drown.

lines.zh: 海浪不断冲刷着{biome}的沙砾，如同时间的潮汐抹去凡人曾存在过的一切痕迹。
lines.en: Waves endlessly scour the sands of {biome}, as the tides of time erase every trace that mortals ever walked here.

lines.zh: 你立于{biome}之上，面向无垠的水域。莫要盯着海平线太久，以免看见不该浮出水面的阴影。
lines.en: You stand upon {biome}, facing the boundless waters. Do not stare too long at the horizon, lest you see what should never surface.

lines.zh: {biome}的菌丝蔓延整片岛屿，呈现出一种异界般的死寂与诡谲的安宁。
lines.en: Mycelium blankets the whole of {biome}, lending it an otherworldly stillness and an eerie, unnatural calm.

lines.zh: 巨大的菌伞矗立在{biome}，宛如来自犹格斯星的异星孢子在此地生根发芽。
lines.en: Giant fungal caps tower across {biome}, as though alien spores from Yuggoth had taken root upon this earth.

lines.zh: 在{biome}，连怪物都似乎被这片菌毯所排斥——然则真正的疯狂从不需要怪物的爪牙。
lines.en: In {biome}, even common monsters seem shunned by the fungal mat—yet true madness needs neither fang nor claw.

lines.zh: 你已抵达{biome}。此地连物质与光线的残渣都已荡然无存，唯余纯粹的虚无。
lines.en: You have reached {biome}. Here not even dregs of matter or light remain—only pure, hollow nothingness.

lines.zh: 在{biome}之中，一切方向都失去了意义。上下左右，皆是无底的黑暗。
lines.en: Within {biome}, all direction loses meaning. Above, below, and around lies only bottomless dark.

lines.zh: {biome}令人联想到外神阿撒托斯所居的混沌中心——盲目、愚痴、却又主宰着一切终局。
lines.en: {biome} recalls the chaotic center where Azathoth dwells—blind, idiot, yet sovereign over every ending.

lines.zh: {biome}的虚空孤岛漂浮在无光之海，宛如被宇宙遗忘的一块碎骨。
lines.en: The void-bound isles of {biome} drift in a lightless sea, like shattered bone forgotten by the cosmos.

lines.zh: 你在{biome}凝望着虚无的深渊。末影生物的低语与奥穆索的回响在此奇妙地交错。
lines.en: You gaze into the void from {biome}. The murmurs of Endermen weave strangely with the echoes of Omothol.

lines.zh: {biome}没有昼夜之分，唯有永恒的紫黑天幕与在虚空中徘徊的末影龙。
lines.en: {biome} knows neither day nor night—only an eternal violet-black vault and the winged sovereign stalking the void.

lines.zh: 你已踏入{biome}。此地的每一寸土地都浸透了珊瑚的腐化，再无半点凡俗的生机。
lines.en: You have stepped into {biome}. Every span of this land is steeped in Coralium corruption, stripped of mortal vitality.

lines.zh: {biome}之中回荡着深渊荒地的悲鸣。唯有被选中的疯子，才敢在此地久留。
lines.en: Within {biome} echoes the wail of the Abyssal Wasteland. Only chosen madmen dare linger here.

lines.zh: 看看{biome}那被侵蚀的岩石与苍白荒芜吧，凡人——这就是主世界拒绝倾听警告的下场。
lines.en: Behold the corroded stone and pale desolation of {biome}, mortal—such is the fate of an Overworld that refused to heed warning.

lines.zh: 你已步入{biome}的疆域。瘟疫、畸变与血肉的狂欢正在这片受诅咒的大地上演。
lines.en: You have crossed into {biome}. Plague, mutation, and a carnival of warped flesh reign upon this accursed soil.

lines.zh: {biome}的一切都在恐惧瘟疫的支配下扭曲蠕动。连岩石都在渗出令人作呕的脓液。
lines.en: All things in {biome} writhe beneath the Dread Plague. Even the stone weeps a sickening ichor.

lines.zh: 此处是{biome}，恐惧野兽查伽洛斯的领地。凡人的血肉在此地不过是待宰的养料。
lines.en: This is {biome}, the domain of Chagaroth the Dread Beast. Mortal flesh here is nothing more than fodder waiting to be claimed.

lines.zh: 你已回到{biome}——我的王国，群星之外最后一座尚且矗立的残破圣城。
lines.en: You have returned to {biome}—my kingdom, the last shattered citadel still standing beyond the stars.

lines.zh: 踏足{biome}的每一寸土地吧，凡人。这里的每一块石砖都铭刻着旧日支配者的威仪。
lines.en: Tread every stone of {biome}, mortal. Each slab here bears the majesty of a Great Old One.

lines.zh: 在{biome}永恒的晦暗中，遗民们仍在低声吟诵着外神的颂词，等待着不可避免的终局。
lines.en: In the eternal twilight of {biome}, the Remnants still chant hymns to the Outer Gods, awaiting the inevitable end.

lines.zh: 你已身处{biome}——那片由暗影编织、被外神遗弃在现实缝隙之外的绝望深渊。
lines.en: You stand within {biome}—that abyss of despair woven of shadow and cast beyond the seams of reality.

lines.zh: 欢迎来到{biome}，凡人。在这里，萨克索斯的怒火与无数暗影生物正窥伺着你的每一步。
lines.en: Welcome to {biome}, mortal. Here the wrath of Sacthoth and countless shadow beings stalk your every step.

lines.zh: {biome}没有太阳，没有星辰，唯有吞噬一切光明的无尽虚暗。
lines.en: {biome} knows neither sun nor stars—only endless, light-devouring gloom.

lines.zh: 你踏入了{biome}。这片被黑暗之地气息浸染的土地，早已成为主世界与深渊之间的前哨。
lines.en: You have entered {biome}. This land steeped in Darklands taint has long served as an outpost between Overworld and Abyss.

lines.zh: {biome}的暗影石与畸变林木正在低语，它们在迎接着来自奥穆索的目光。
lines.en: The Darkstone and twisted timber of {biome} murmur in welcome to a gaze turned down from Omothol.

lines.zh: 在{biome}，连大地本身都透着不祥的晦暗。深渊的影子早已在此扎根。
lines.en: In {biome}, the very earth wears an ominous pallor. The shadow of the Abyss struck root here long ago.

lines.zh: 你仍在{dimension}。这片看似安宁、充满阳光与绿意的大地，正是深渊最理想的牧场。
lines.en: You remain in {dimension}. This seemingly tranquil earth of sun and green is the Abyss's finest pasture.

lines.zh: {dimension}的凡人每日耕作、筑城、繁衍，却从未察觉地底深处早已埋下了黑暗之地的种子。
lines.en: The mortals of {dimension} till, build, and multiply each day, blind to the Darklands seeds already buried beneath their feet.

lines.zh: 在{dimension}的蓝天之下，人们将秩序视为理所当然。多么天真，又多么脆弱的幻想。
lines.en: Beneath the blue skies of {dimension}, mortals take order for granted. How naive, and how brittle an illusion.

lines.zh: {dimension}只是无数世界中最表层的一页。翻开它，背后便是深渊荒地与无尽的疯狂。
lines.en: {dimension} is merely the topmost page of countless worlds. Turn it, and behind it lie the Abyssal Wasteland and endless madness.

lines.zh: 你置身于{dimension}。滚烫的硫磺与永恒的火焰在这里翻涌，恰似宇宙诞生前尚未冷却的余烬。
lines.en: You stand within {dimension}. Seething sulfur and undying flame churn here like uncooled embers from before the cosmos.

lines.zh: {dimension}充斥着暴虐与诅咒，然则这片火狱的法则，比起外神的混沌仍显得过于直白。
lines.en: {dimension} brims with fury and curse; yet the laws of this furnace remain crude beside the chaos of the Outer Gods.

lines.zh: 在{dimension}的岩浆海之上，恶魂的哀鸣与死灵之书的嘶哑低语遥相呼应。
lines.en: Above the magma seas of {dimension}, the wails of ghasts answer the hoarse whispers of the Necronomicon.

lines.zh: 炽热的空气扭曲了{dimension}的视线。小心莫让火焰烧毁了你仅存的理智。
lines.en: Scorching air warps all sight in {dimension}. Take care the flames do not consume what little sanity you retain.

lines.zh: {dimension}是一片漂浮在无光虚空中的破碎遗迹，充满了异界的高傲与死寂。
lines.en: {dimension} is a shattered remnant adrift in lightless void, steeped in alien pride and dead silence.

lines.zh: 在{dimension}的漆黑天幕下，末影之物以一种令深渊都觉得荒诞的姿态守望着虚无。
lines.en: Beneath the pitch-black vault of {dimension}, the things of the End keep watch over nothingness in a manner even the Abyss finds absurd.

lines.zh: 虚空在{dimension}的脚下张开。此处虽无珊瑚与恐惧，却同样散发着末世的寒意。
lines.en: The void yawns beneath {dimension}. Though free of Coralium and Dread, it exhales the same chill of an ended age.

lines.zh: {dimension}的居民厌恶直视，而深渊却偏偏喜欢将一切都看得一清二楚。
lines.en: The denizens of {dimension} despise being looked upon, whereas the Abyss delights in seeing all things laid bare.

lines.zh: 你已踏入{dimension}。这片苍白、死寂、被珊瑚瘟疫彻底吞噬的维度，正是人类盲目探索深渊的第一个墓碑。
lines.en: You have entered {dimension}. Pale, desolate, and devoured by the Coralium Plague, this realm is humanity's first tombstone for meddling with the Abyss.

lines.zh: 在{dimension}中，无尽的骸骨与液态珊瑚见证了阿索拉曾统治的纪元。
lines.en: Across {dimension}, endless bone and liquid Coralium bear witness to the age once ruled by Asorah.

lines.zh: 抬头望向{dimension}那灰暗无光的天幕吧。这里没有救赎，只有蔓延不绝的畸变与腐化。
lines.en: Look up at the dim, lightless vault of {dimension}. Here there is no salvation—only creeping mutation and rot.

lines.zh: {dimension}的食尸鬼与深渊僵尸正在黑暗中游荡，它们曾是你这样的探索者。
lines.en: Ghouls and Abyssal zombies prowl the gloom of {dimension}; once, they too were explorers like you.

lines.zh: 你进入了{dimension}。欢迎来到这片被恐惧瘟疫撕裂、由查伽洛斯统治的血肉炼狱。
lines.en: You have entered {dimension}. Welcome to the inferno of warped flesh torn by the Dread Plague and ruled by Chagaroth.

lines.zh: 在{dimension}，连大地都在痛苦地痉挛。恐惧守卫与畸变野兽在红雾中嘶吼不休。
lines.en: In {dimension}, the very earth convulses in agony. Dreadguards and mutated beasts howl endlessly through the crimson haze.

lines.zh: 你为何来到{dimension}？是为了寻觅惧质，还是为了亲眼见证理智被恐惧彻底碾碎？
lines.en: Why have you come to {dimension}? To harvest Dreadium, or to watch sanity crushed beneath sheer Dread?

lines.zh: {dimension}的瘴气令人作呕，空气中充满了铁锈与腐肉的气味。
lines.en: The miasma of {dimension} turns the stomach, thick with the stench of rust and rotting meat.

lines.zh: 你已抵达{dimension}——我的圣城，通往深渊之书与终极禁忌的最后门廊。
lines.en: You have arrived at {dimension}—my citadel, the final threshold leading to the Abyssalnomicon and ultimate forbidden truth.

lines.zh: 欢迎来到你的末日，凡人，我是认真的。{dimension}从不宽恕任何企图亵渎旧日支配者的人。
lines.en: Welcome to your doom, mortal—I mean it. {dimension} forgives none who seek to profane a Great Old One.

lines.zh: 在{dimension}之中，现实的概念早已破碎。你所见的一切断壁残垣，皆是过往文明疯狂的见证。
lines.en: Within {dimension}, the concept of reality has long shattered. Every broken wall you see bears witness to the madness of vanished ages.

lines.zh: 你竟披着我的形态走进了{dimension}？这究竟是莫大的讽刺，还是你已彻底陷入了幻觉？
lines.en: You walk into {dimension} wearing my own likeness? Is this supreme irony, or have you succumbed wholly to delusion?

lines.zh: 欢迎来到{dimension}——黑暗之源、群星之外最深沉的梦魇之底。
lines.en: Welcome to {dimension}—the wellspring of darkness, the deepest floor of nightmare beyond the stars.

lines.zh: 在{dimension}里，萨克索斯的凝视无处不在。这片虚暗领域从不欢迎任何血肉之躯。
lines.en: Within {dimension}, the gaze of Sacthoth is everywhere. This realm of shadow welcomes no creature of flesh.

lines.zh: 你竟敢踏足{dimension}？莫非你以为披着扎哈尔的空壳，便能在此地横行无忌？
lines.en: You dare set foot in {dimension}? Do you imagine wearing J'zahar's hollow shell grants you free reign here?

lines.zh: {dimension}的每一寸空间都在排斥着光明与生命。你的理智在此地正以肉眼可见的速度崩塌。
lines.en: Every span of {dimension} rejects light and life. Your sanity here erodes before your very eyes.

lines.zh: 你跨越了界域的裂隙，踏入了一片名为{dimension}的陌生维度。
lines.en: You have crossed a rift between worlds into an unfamiliar realm named {dimension}.

lines.zh: 无论{dimension}遵循着怎样的法则，在犹格·索托斯眼中，所有维度都不过是同一扇门后的不同房间。
lines.en: Whatever laws govern {dimension}, to Yog-Sothoth every dimension is merely another chamber behind the same Gate.

lines.zh: {dimension}的空气带着异界的气息。记住，深渊的触角从不受限于已知的星图。
lines.en: The air of {dimension} carries an alien tang. Remember: the reach of the Abyss is never bound by known star-charts.

lines.zh: 你在{dimension}探索着未知，却不知未知本身也在用千万只眼睛打量着你。
lines.en: You explore the unknown in {dimension}, unaware that the unknown itself appraises you with a thousand eyes.

lines.zh: {biome}的潮汐受着月相与群星的牵引，而群星，终有一日会回到它们应有的位置。
lines.en: The tides of {biome} answer the moon and the stars—and the stars, one day, shall return to their appointed places.

lines.zh: 海水冰冷而深邃，正如深渊之水般拒绝透出任何一丝光明。
lines.en: The sea is cold and fathomless, refusing to yield a single spark of light from its abyssal floor.

lines.zh: 莫要轻易潜入{biome}最幽暗的海沟，有些门扉一旦在水下开启，便再无合拢之日。
lines.en: Do not lightly dive into the darkest trenches of {biome}; some gates, once opened beneath the waves, never close again.

lines.zh: 在{biome}的幽暗小径上行走时，莫要回头去数身后究竟有几道影子。
lines.en: As you walk the dim trails of {biome}, do not turn back to count how many shadows follow behind you.

lines.zh: 树皮的纹路扭曲盘结，竟隐约拼出死灵之书中某种禁忌的符印。
lines.en: The grain of the bark twists into knots that vaguely trace a forbidden sigil from the Necronomicon.

lines.zh: {biome}的雾气在树干间缠绕，将现实与梦境的边界悄悄抹去。
lines.en: Mist coils between the trunks of {biome}, quietly blurring the border between waking and dream.

lines.zh: {biome}偶尔传来的寂静，比野兽的嚎叫更令人不安——那是连虫豸都屏住呼吸的时刻。
lines.en: The sudden silences of {biome} are more unsettling than any beast's howl—the moments when even insects hold their breath.

lines.zh: 即便在{biome}这样寻常的林地里，深渊的触角也随时可能从树根下悄然探出。
lines.en: Even in a woodland as ordinary as {biome}, the tendrils of the Abyss may surface at any moment from beneath the roots.

lines.zh: 沙丘在风中缓缓迁徙，恰似奈亚拉托提普在尘世间不断变换的千百副面孔。
lines.en: The dunes shift slowly in the wind, like the thousand shifting masks of Nyarlathotep.

lines.zh: 在{biome}的无尽沙海里迷失方向，往往是凡人第一次听见沙格斯低吼的开端。
lines.en: Losing one's way in the endless sands of {biome} is often how mortals first hear the distant bellow of a Shoggoth.

lines.zh: 烈风卷起{biome}的沙尘，遮蔽了前路，却遮不住头顶那片冷漠的苍穹。
lines.en: Hot gusts whip the dust of {biome}, blinding the path ahead yet leaving the indifferent heavens bare above.

lines.zh: 群山沉默地耸立了千万年，它们见过无数文明的兴衰，也终将见证深渊的降临。
lines.en: The mountains have stood in silence for aeons; they have watched empires crumble, and they shall witness the Abyss descend.

lines.zh: 在{biome}的险峻山脊上，一步踏空便是万劫不复的深渊。
lines.en: Along the jagged ridges of {biome}, a single misstep plunges into an unforgiving chasm.

lines.zh: 云雾缠绕着{biome}的峰巅，隐藏着不为人知的洞窟与沉睡于岩层中的恐惧。
lines.en: Clouds wreath the peaks of {biome}, concealing nameless caverns and horrors slumbering within the rock.

lines.zh: {biome}是疾病与腐朽的温床，连阳光落在这里也显得有气无力。
lines.en: {biome} is a cradle of blight and decay; even sunlight falls sickly and weak upon its pools.

lines.zh: 脚下的淤泥发出黏腻的声响，仿佛有无数双苍白的手正试图将你拖入{biome}深处。
lines.en: Sucking mud clings to your boots, as though countless pale hands were straining to drag you beneath {biome}.

lines.zh: 莫要轻视{biome}的寂静——沼泽从不张扬它的吞噬。
lines.en: Do not scorn the stillness of {biome}—a swamp never announces what it swallows.

lines.zh: {biome}的恶魔与猪灵只懂得暴虐与贪婪，他们甚至不配听闻外神的真名。
lines.en: The fiends of {biome} know only brutality and greed; they are unworthy even to hear the true names of the Outer Gods.

lines.zh: 浓烟遮蔽了{biome}的穹顶，仿佛这片火海正试图将自己与真正的宇宙隔绝开来。
lines.en: Thick smoke chokes the vault of {biome}, as though this sea of fire sought to seal itself off from the true cosmos.

lines.zh: 纵然{biome}炽烈如斯，也无法融化深渊守门人眼中那万古不变的寒意。
lines.en: Fierce as {biome} may burn, it cannot thaw the ageless chill in the eyes of the Gatekeeper of the Abyss.

lines.zh: {biome}的寒风如刀，刮过这具借来的躯壳。记住，在群星之间，寒冷才是永恒的常态。
lines.en: The gale of {biome} cuts like a blade across this borrowed shell. Remember: among the stars, cold is the eternal rule.

lines.zh: {biome}的寂静最容易让人产生幻听——你听见风雪中夹杂着的阿克洛语低吟了吗？
lines.en: The silence of {biome} breeds phantom voices—do you hear the Aklo murmurs woven into the howling snow?

lines.zh: 万物在{biome}中蛰伏或枯萎，唯有深渊的凝视不受寒暑所限。
lines.en: All things hibernate or wither in {biome}; only the gaze of the Abyss knows neither frost nor thaw.

lines.zh: {biome}看似生机勃勃，实则是一座弱肉强食、毫无怜悯的绿色囚笼。
lines.en: {biome} appears bursting with life, yet it is a merciless green prison where flesh devours flesh.

lines.zh: 苔藓爬满了{biome}的巨石，将不知多少纪元前的石刻悄悄吞没。
lines.en: Moss creeps over the monoliths of {biome}, swallowing carvings left behind countless ages ago.

lines.zh: 在{biome}那令人窒息的闷热里，连理智都会随着汗水一同蒸发。
lines.en: In the suffocating heat of {biome}, even sanity evaporates alongside your sweat.

lines.zh: {biome}的色彩浓烈而荒诞，仿佛某位狂乱的画师用干涸的血液涂抹而成。
lines.en: The hues of {biome} are fierce and unnatural, as if smeared across the earth with dried blood by a mad painter.

lines.zh: 寂静盘踞在{biome}的峡谷之间，连风声都带着几分干涸的沙哑。
lines.en: Silence broods among the canyons of {biome}, and even the wind carries a parched, rasping edge.

lines.zh: 高耸的岩壁俯瞰着你，正如奥穆索的残垣俯瞰着迷途的朝圣者。
lines.en: Towering cliffs look down upon you, much as the ruins of Omothol watch a lost pilgrim.

lines.zh: 凡人喜爱在{biome}建立城邦与农田，却从不思考这片平地之下究竟掩埋过多少个纪元。
lines.en: Mortals love to raise towns and fields upon {biome}, never asking how many ages lie buried beneath the turf.

lines.zh: {biome}的天空显得格外低垂，仿佛随时会倾覆下来，将所有生灵压成尘埃。
lines.en: The sky hangs unusually low over {biome}, as if poised to collapse and crush all living things to dust.

lines.zh: 草叶摩挲的低响在{biome}回荡，像是一群看不见的信徒正在齐声诵念。
lines.en: The whisper of brushing grass echoes across {biome}, like an unseen congregation chanting in unison.

lines.zh: 你独行在{biome}之上，远方的地平线看似触手可及，实则永远遥不可及。
lines.en: You wander across {biome}; the distant horizon seems within reach, yet forever slips away.

lines.zh: 这片平静的{biome}不过是一块尚未被珊瑚或恐惧染指的画布罢了。
lines.en: This quiet {biome} is merely a blank canvas not yet claimed by Coralium or Dread.

lines.zh: 流水带走了落叶与尘埃，却带不走沉溺在{biome}水底的冰冷记忆。
lines.en: The river carries away fallen leaves and dust, yet cannot sweep away the cold memories drowned in {biome}.

lines.zh: {biome}的水声掩盖了岸边草丛里的动静。小心你的身后，凡人。
lines.en: The rush of {biome} masks every rustle in the bankside reeds. Mind what stands behind you, mortal.

lines.zh: 即便是最清澈的{biome}，在珊瑚瘟疫降临之时，也会在一夜之间化作剧毒的蓝潮。
lines.en: Even the clearest {biome}, should the Coralium Plague strike, turns overnight into a venomous blue tide.

lines.zh: {biome}的潮声低沉而规律，宛如沉睡在海底古都中的存在正缓缓呼吸。
lines.en: The surf of {biome} booms low and rhythmic, like the slow breathing of something asleep in a sunken city.

lines.zh: 沙粒在你的脚下流散。在这片{biome}上，没有任何足迹能留存到下一个涨潮。
lines.en: Sand shifts beneath your heels. Along {biome}, no footprint endures until the next high tide.

lines.zh: 海风从{biome}掠过，带来远方深海的咸腥与某种古老而冰冷的叹息。
lines.en: Sea winds sweep across {biome}, bearing the brine of distant depths and a chill, ancient sigh.

lines.zh: 你踩在{biome}松软的菌丝上，可曾想过整座岛屿或许本就是一个巨大的活体？
lines.en: Treading the spongy mycelium of {biome}, have you considered that the entire island may be a single living organism?

lines.zh: {biome}的色彩灰紫而阴郁，恰似腐朽的梦境在现实中留下的斑驳印记。
lines.en: The hues of {biome} are bruised violet and ash, like mottled stains left behind by a decaying dream.

lines.zh: 纵使没有杀戮的喧嚣，{biome}的寂静本身也足以让孤独的灵魂悄然发狂。
lines.en: Even free of slaughter, the hush of {biome} alone is enough to drive a solitary mind quietly mad.

lines.zh: 你悬停在{biome}的边缘，听不见任何回响。因为虚空从不回答凡人的呼喊。
lines.en: You linger at the edge of {biome} and hear no echo; for the Void never answers a mortal cry.

lines.zh: 此处是{biome}，连时间本身也已在此冻结或消散。
lines.en: This is {biome}, where time itself has either frozen or dissolved.

lines.zh: 若非这具傀儡尚且维系着你的轮廓，你在{biome}中早已化作一缕无名尘埃。
lines.en: Were it not for this simulacrum still holding your outline, you would already have dissolved to nameless dust in {biome}.

lines.zh: 站在{biome}的边缘，只需向前迈出一步，便是连旧日支配者也懒得俯视的虚无。
lines.en: At the rim of {biome}, a single step forward leads into a nothingness even the Great Old Ones scarcely care to inspect.

lines.zh: {biome}的紫颂与黑曜石见证了界域的破碎，恰如现实在犹格·索托斯面前崩溃的缩影。
lines.en: The chorus and obsidian of {biome} bear witness to a shattered realm—a miniature of reality collapsing before Yog-Sothoth.

lines.zh: 这片{biome}虽非奥穆索，却同样散发着末日降临后的冰冷死气。
lines.en: Though {biome} is not Omothol, it exhales the same cold, dead stillness of an ended world.

lines.zh: {biome}的空气里弥漫着珊瑚瘟疫的腥甜。若没有防护，连你的骨髓也会化作苍蓝的结晶。
lines.en: The air of {biome} reeks of the sweet rot of the Coralium Plague. Unshielded, even your marrow would crystallize in sickly blue.

lines.zh: 在{biome}，连死灵之书的书页都会微微发烫，仿佛在向这片沦陷之地致意。
lines.en: In {biome}, even the pages of the Necronomicon grow warm, as if saluting a fallen realm.

lines.zh: Iä! {biome}不过是深渊向现世伸出的第一道触须，真正的噩梦尚在更深处沉睡。
lines.en: Iä! {biome} is merely the first tendril the Abyss extends into the waking world; the true nightmare slumbers deeper still.

lines.zh: 在{biome}中呼吸的每一口空气，都可能将恐惧的种子埋入你的肺腑。
lines.en: Every breath drawn in {biome} risks planting the seed of Dread deep within your lungs.

lines.zh: 红雾与焦土构成了{biome}的轮廓。莫要在此久留，除非你渴望沦为恐惧守卫的同类。
lines.en: Crimson mist and blighted earth define {biome}. Do not tarry here, unless you yearn to join the ranks of the Dreadguards.

lines.zh: Iä! {biome}的惨状正是深渊赐予贪婪者的礼物——越是渴望力量，便越是面目全非。
lines.en: Iä! The horror of {biome} is the Abyss's gift to the greedy—the more power they crave, the less human they remain.

lines.zh: {biome}的空气里流动着纯粹的恐惧与位能。这具空心傀儡终于回到了它的源头。
lines.en: Pure dread and Potential Energy drift through the air of {biome}. This hollow puppet has returned at last to its source.

lines.zh: 看看{biome}的神庙与断壁吧。即便你曾击碎过我的幻影，你也永远无法杀死真正的扎哈尔。
lines.en: Behold the temples and broken walls of {biome}. Though you may have shattered my simulacrum, you can never slay the true J'zahar.

lines.zh: Iä! {biome}的钟声早已停摆，唯有深渊的凝视依然笼罩着这片失落之境。
lines.en: Iä! The bells of {biome} fell silent long ago; only the Abyssal gaze still broods over this lost domain.

lines.zh: 在{biome}的黑暗里，连你身上的这具傀儡也不过是更大阴影中的一粒微尘。
lines.en: Within the darkness of {biome}, even this simulacrum you wear is scarcely a mote inside a greater shadow.

lines.zh: 此处便是{biome}。你若在此陨落，连一丝残魂都不会被放回主世界。
lines.en: This is {biome}. Should you perish here, not a shred of your soul will ever be yielded back to the Overworld.

lines.zh: Nilgh'ri... {biome}的每一阵阴风都在呼唤着黑暗之主的真名。
lines.en: Nilgh'ri... Every bleak gust in {biome} whispers the true names of the lords of darkness.

lines.zh: 小心{biome}中游荡的暗影潜行者与深渊生物。在这片土地上，连光明都显得格格不入。
lines.en: Beware the shadow beasts prowling {biome}. Upon this soil, even daylight seems an intruder.

lines.zh: {biome}是禁忌仪式的理想之地，这里的每一块石头都渴望着位能的灌注。
lines.en: {biome} is fertile ground for forbidden rites; every stone here thirsts for the pouring of Potential Energy.

lines.zh: 你站在{biome}之上，是否感觉到脚底正传来与奥穆索同频的震颤？
lines.en: Standing upon {biome}, do you feel the tremor beneath your soles beating in unison with Omothol?

lines.zh: 你带着从奥穆索借来的形貌回到{dimension}，难道是想让这些凡人提前瞻仰他们的终局？
lines.en: You return to {dimension} wearing a likeness borrowed from Omothol—do you mean to grant these mortals an early glimpse of their end?

lines.zh: 珍惜{dimension}尚且完整的模样吧。当群星归位之时，连山海也会在瞬间改写。
lines.en: Cherish {dimension} while it remains whole. When the stars are right, mountain and sea alike shall be rewritten in an instant.

lines.zh: {dimension}是凡人认知中最古老的地狱，却远远算不上深渊的终点。
lines.en: {dimension} is the oldest hell known to mortals, yet it lies nowhere near the true bottom of the Abyss.

lines.zh: 哪怕在{dimension}的烈焰中心，黑暗国度的阴影依然能找到栖身之所。
lines.en: Even at the fiery heart of {dimension}, the shadow of the Dark Realm still finds room to linger.

lines.zh: 你在{dimension}徘徊，恰似一个迷失在星辰坟场中的幽灵。
lines.en: You wander {dimension} like a ghost lost within a graveyard of stars.

lines.zh: 即便征服了{dimension}的巨龙，在真正的旧日支配者眼中，你也不过是折断了一根微不足道的骨刺。
lines.en: Even should you slay the dragon of {dimension}, in the eyes of a Great Old One you have snapped no more than a trivial spur.

lines.zh: 小心{dimension}中的每一滴蓝色液体。珊瑚不会怜悯任何试图掠夺它力量的凡人。
lines.en: Beware every drop of blue liquid in {dimension}. Coralium shows no mercy to mortals who seek to plunder its power.

lines.zh: 你携着我的形貌行走在{dimension}，仿佛一位旧日君王正在巡视自己早已腐烂的边疆。
lines.en: Walking {dimension} in my likeness, you resemble an ancient sovereign inspecting a frontier long since rotted away.

lines.zh: 记住我在阿索拉陨落时说过的话：你们终究要为自己的傲慢付出代价，而{dimension}正是第一道刑场。
lines.en: Remember what was spoken at Asorah's fall: you mortals shall pay for your arrogance, and {dimension} is the first scaffold.

lines.zh: 在这血红的{dimension}中，唯有力量与疯狂能让你活过下一个呼吸。
lines.en: Within blood-red {dimension}, only strength and madness will carry you past the next breath.

lines.zh: {dimension}的遗民们正在注视着你。只要他们还认得死灵之书的气息，便会向你低头或拔刀。
lines.en: The Remnants of {dimension} are watching you. So long as they scent the Necronomicon, they will bow—or draw steel.

lines.zh: Iä! {dimension}的钟声为你而鸣，傀儡。去面对你亲手招致的宿命吧。
lines.en: Iä! The bells of {dimension} toll for you, puppet. Go face the doom you summoned with your own hands.

lines.zh: Iä! {dimension}没有尽头，亦无归途。唯有最强韧的疯子，才能在此地保全一丝清醒。
lines.en: Iä! {dimension} has neither end nor return. Only the most hardened madman keeps a shred of clarity here.

lines.zh: 暗影生物在{dimension}中如潮水般涌动，它们只听从最古老的黑暗法则。
lines.en: Shadow creatures surge like a tide through {dimension}, obeying naught but the oldest laws of darkness.

lines.zh: 哪怕远离了奥穆索，这具傀儡体内的位能依然能让你在{dimension}听见我的声音。
lines.en: Far though you may be from Omothol, the Potential Energy within this vessel still lets you hear my voice in {dimension}.

lines.zh: 莫要以为换了一片天地，便能摆脱{dimension}之外那道永恒的凝望。
lines.en: Do not imagine that changing skies frees you from the eternal gaze watching beyond {dimension}.
